2. It allows my light-squared bishop to develop more easily
3. The doubled c-pawns aren't as problematic when they're not blocking my own pieces
4. It keeps my queenside pawn structure more flexible

After dxc6, I can follow up with developing my light-squared bishop to e7 or d6, castling, and connecting my rooks.
